messages:
Priya: FYI during a customer demo at 15:03 UTC their saved-search preview showed rows from another workspace for ~15s. Got screenshots. :grimacing:
Derek: can you drop the raw request/headers?
Priya: request: POST /api/saved_search/preview 
Headers: X-Org: 277; Cookie: session=...; affinity=preview-2
Body: {"saved_search_id":"ss-99"}
Priya: response had rows with workspace_id: 18 (our staging test workspace) even though header was 277
Chen: timeline? any deploys around then?
deploy-bot: Release observable-preview v2 rolled to 30% at 2025-07-09T15:00:40Z
Omar: preview service does a cached lookup in redis with key = saved_search_id. historically we include org in key but someone recently refactored the cache helper. looks suspicious.
Maya: I traced logs: preview fetch + prefetch for left-nav can interleave. prefetch path calls /internal/search without X-Org and writes to redis. then when real request arrives it reads cached value (missing org scope)
Derek: that matches. intermittent and only during rollout because two code paths (old vs new) write differently.
Priya: repro in staging by hammering preview for two orgs while toggling rollout. I can reproduce ~1/20 tries.
Chen: quick mitigation: set redis keys to include org prefix again, and add a short-lived namespacing token (preview_ns) per org.
Omar: also add a sanity check on read: if cached.payload.workspace_id != request.header.X-Org then treat as cache miss and delete key. safe fail-open? probably fail-closed (return 403) for preview? we should prefer showing nothing rather than leaking.
Priya: customer already notified. They asked for root cause and timeline.
Derek: let's rollback the rollout and ship small patch to cache key ASAP.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for observable-preview v2 at 2025-07-09T15:05:10Z by Derek.
Maya: follow-up: add unit tests for cache helper, and an e2e that simulates concurrent prefetch + preview request with two org headers.
Omar: I'll add telemetry: counter for "preview.cache.org_mismatch" and a sample log with saved_search_id + cached_workspace_id + request_org. Hook to eng-platform dashboard alert if >0 in prod.
Chen: PR incoming in 30m to reintroduce org-namespacing and the defensive read check.
Derek: assign owners: Omar telemetry, Chen PR & tests, Maya help with e2e, Priya customer comms + postmortem.
Priya: thanks everyone. will post incident summary in #incidents once patch is live. :white_check_mark:
